messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a quick, step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and for a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a good wipe‑down, polish the finish, and tune it to pitch. | A well‑presented instrument looks more appealing and shows you care. | | **2. Take Quality Photos** | Shoot from multiple angles (headstock, body, back, neck, strings, any flaws). Use natural light and a neutral background. | Great photos attract buyers and reduce the chance of returns. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, and local classifieds. Note price ranges for similar models, ages, and conditions. | Helps you set a realistic, competitive price. | | **4. Write a Clear Listing** | Include:
• Brand, model, year, serial number
• Condition (new, like new, used, any damage)
• Features (pickup type, finish, hardware)
• Reason for selling
• High‑resolution photos
• Asking price | Transparency builds trust and speeds up the sale. | | **5. Choose Your Platforms** | • **Reverb** – great for musical instruments, global reach.
• **eBay** – auction or fixed price, large audience.
• **Craigslist / Facebook Marketplace** – local, no shipping hassles.
• **Local music stores** – some accept consignment or trade‑in.
• **Reddit** (r/Guitar, r/AcousticGuitar) – niche community. | Different platforms reach different buyer types; use a mix for maximum exposure. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start a bit above your target to allow room for negotiation. Consider adding a “$X shipping” option if you’re willing to ship. | Buyers often expect to haggle; a higher starting point can still land you a good deal. | | **7. Handle Inquiries Promptly** | Respond within a few hours, answer questions honestly, and offer to send additional photos or videos if requested. | Good communication reduces buyer hesitation. | | **8. Arrange Safe Payment & Shipping** | • For local sales: meet in a public place, accept cash or Venmo.
• For online sales: use PayPal Goods & Services or a secure escrow.
• Ship with a reputable carrier (UPS, FedEx, USPS) and insure the package. | Protects both parties and ensures the guitar arrives safely. | | **9. Package Properly** | Use a sturdy guitar case or a padded box, add bubble wrap or packing peanuts, and seal with strong tape. Label the package as “Fragile.” | Prevents damage during transit. | | **10. Follow Up** | After the sale, confirm receipt, thank the buyer, and ask for a quick review if applicable. | Positive reviews help future sales and build your reputation. | ### Quick Tips - **Timing**: Spring and summer are peak times for instrument sales (students returning to school, people buying for summer gigs). - **Condition**: If there are scratches, cracks, or worn hardware, disclose them upfront. You can offer a lower price or negotiate a “fix‑it” deal. - **Extras**: Including a strap, extra strings, or a cleaning kit can sweeten the deal. - **Safety**: Never hand over money before the guitar is paid for and shipped (or before the buyer has inspected it in person). ### Example Listing (Reverb) > **Title**: 2015 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition > **Description**: > • 2015 Yamaha FG800, natural finish, 25.5" scale. > • Clean, no visible scratches. > • Tuned to standard EADGBE. > • Comes with a hard case, strap, and 2 sets of strings. > • Reason for selling: upgrading to a 12‑string. > **Price**: $350 (negotiable). > **Shipping**: $30 flat rate (insured). > **Photos**: 8 high‑res images attached. --- **Bottom line:** Clean, photograph, research, list on multiple platforms, price competitively, and handle transactions securely. Good luck with your sale!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We can give steps: research market value, clean and maintain, take photos, list on platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb, local classifieds), set price, describe condition, shipping options, safety tips. Also mention potential appraisal, trade-in, etc. Provide a concise guide. No function call needed.
